name: type7-mmsi3-beyond-the-input-is-absent
reference: 22 characters = 132 bits (fill 4). mmsi3 at bits 104-133 needs 134 bits, so it and mmsiseq3 are absent (`optional`, engine-spec 0.6). gpsd reports mmsi3 836359488 for this sentence, a value that needs bits past the 128 the sentence carries (132 less 4 fill bits); the pack leaves mmsi3 absent. Expect differs from input: L = 104 (mmsiseq2 ends at bit 104), 18 characters with 4 zero fill bits; the input's characters past bit 107 are dropped.
